authority.hash_scope: Exact Git blob bytes at source_revision; portable across checkout line endings
authority.scope: S01 frozen native, memory, map and UI targets and reference profiles

authority.hash_scope: Exact Git blob bytes at source_revision; portable across checkout line endings
authority.scope: Existing 60 FPS focused-viewer target, detailed aircraft and unchanged current art ceilings

reference.concurrent_work_policy: No task compilation, tests, fixture aging or other qualification lane during authoritative timing. Record existing user applications; do not terminate them or unrelated processes. Close only disposable test-owned processes during normal cleanup.
reference.unavailable_or_software_gpu: Record explicitly. It cannot silently stand in for the agreed discrete reference GPU. Keep the affected reference-hardware cell open.

source_campaign.provenance: Actual S19 funded construction, company procurement, delivered aircraft, supported flight and readiness recovery; preserved original save. This proves those recorded outcomes, not that every current feature rule is active.
source_campaign.preparation: After the recorded ordinary enable adoption, age copies through actual native daily simulation with the enabled qualification rules and retained history. No edited dates, fabricated age labels, grants, removed history or invented feature activity. Record commands, dates, rules and active ledger/force/company/AI counts. Preserve original-source, adopted-early and prepared-input hashes.
source_campaign.observed_rule_gap: The earned France source has economic_competition=false. Supplier/military AI enable flags do not establish active planning because their ticks are gated by economic competition.

required_adoption.method: Apply the ordinary native command once to a disposable source copy; preserve the original. Record command result, date, before/after rules and complete save hashes. The adopted early checkpoint is a new input identity, not the original raw save hash.
required_adoption.qualification: Require the enabled economic-competition rule and inspect actual supplier/military AI planning/workload receipts during subsequent daily preparation. Flags alone are not proof of executed work.

source_campaign.superseded_preparation: The original passive prepare01 lineage is retained as a diagnostic attempt and cannot serve as qualification. Restart or resume from the declared adopted lineage with explicit before/after provenance.

cases.meaning: Early feature-rich recorded campaign; not a claim of 1990 startup coverage
Actual mid-2010s campaign aged from the preserved source
Actual end-2035 campaign; last measured day is the CP1 endpoint

native.configuration: Already-built release native executable, dedicated process, one lane at a time; no Cargo/build time in daily samples
native.sample_order: All consecutive one-day samples after each actual anchor; retain every sample including spikes
native.whole_turn: Measure each complete server turn around simulation/history, state read-model generation, JSON serialization, and selected-country history delta query/serialization. Never sum stage percentiles.
native.memory: Retain raw samples at nominal 100 ms or finer, observed OS peak working set, maximum sampled private bytes, actual gaps and failed/final sample availability. Apply both 1 GiB limits across the dedicated process. Sampled private bytes are not a guaranteed instantaneous peak.
native.throughput: Record completed days divided by actual full timed daily-loop elapsed seconds, plus raw loop boundaries; keep fixture preparation, loading, process startup, disk autosave and network/browser work separately labeled. Do not use 1000/median as sustained throughput.

browser.cases: All three declared actual anchor inputs from the adopted lineage: 1999-05-13, 2015-01-01 and 2035-11-30, loaded unedited into disposable servers. Browser late coverage is explicitly 30 November; the native 31-day window supplies actual 31 December endpoint timing and state facts. Do not label the browser input as 31 December.
browser.profile_freeze: Record exact visible settings and camera workload parameters in the candidate input/configuration manifest before the first qualification round; reuse them unchanged for confirmation. Do not add flags or lower detail after observing a failure without retaining it and starting a new candidate pair.
browser.settle_policy: Record the first 3 s settling/cold-view work separately. It is an explicit predefined phase, not a retrospectively removed slow interval.
browser.fps_definition: Count actual completed globe redraws during the complete 12 s active-navigation window and divide by its full elapsed seconds, including blocked time and scheduling gaps. Invoke the real WebGL finish after each actual draw to confirm completed GPU work; retain raw draw durations, completion times, intervals and draw-call confirmations. This conservative synchronization is part of the frozen method. Idle requestAnimationFrame callbacks do not count.

inspection.model: The released air_fighter inspection asset shown by the actual native equipment designer in the loaded campaign, with at least 100,000 inspection triangles; record asset revision, visible design/catalog specification and measured mesh count. It may differ from the S19 delivered light-attack aircraft; this rendering test does not assert procurement stock ownership or delivery of the displayed design.
inspection.workload: 3 s separately recorded settling followed by 12 s actual focused-model orbit/navigation, using the same completed-draw/full-window principle; retain actual CPU/GPU cadence and model cost
inspection.comparison: Use the unrounded observed value; 59.x does not pass 60. No invented tolerance or waiver.

ui_controls.boundary: Trusted control-event timestamp through confirmed corresponding camera-state change, two requestAnimationFrame paint opportunities and real GL finish completion. This measures local UI handling plus scheduled paint opportunity/GPU completion, not proof of compositor presentation or scanout. The local controls issue no read request, so no server/read-response latency is claimed.
ui_controls.workload: 31 visible trusted camera-control clicks per dated case/detail profile, starting at the national France view with zoom 8: repeat west, east, zoom-in, zoom-out in that order, stopping after action 31. Retain every control identity, trusted-event timestamp, before/after camera state, asserted state change and latency. Freeze exact button selectors and initial camera parameters in the candidate manifest before either qualification round.
ui_controls.sequence_rule: Repeat ordered_controls; take the first 31 entries

browser.lifecycle: Measure inspection and CityMesh/cache bounds, lazy loading, repeated room visits, context loss/recovery and disposal using actual buffer/cache/draw observations. The separate gallery TownMesh plan does not qualify the campaign CityMesh path.
browser.cold_loading: Fresh disposable browser profile/context and uncached page entry; report navigation-to-usable and first actual map/inspection draw separately, retaining requests and trace. Do not mix warm reloads or save-load latency with cold page loading.
browser.memory: Record JS heap availability/method, browser process observations when available, queried GL buffer sizes, API-declared texture texel payloads and cache counters separately. Texture declarations are not verified successful physical allocations; unknown layouts remain unknown/null rather than zero. Neither these payload counters nor OS process bytes are physical driver VRAM measurements; no total-VRAM claim.
browser.cache_contract: Pin the existing inspection and CityMesh cache limits from source/tests in the candidate manifest before timing. Compare actual observed counters with those limits; do not widen them to pass or substitute the hypothetical offline inventory. A renderer/cache implementation change starts a new full qualification pair.

acceptance.comparison: Evaluate every cell independently using raw unrounded measurements; no pooled p95 or fast-case averaging hides a failed case. Both complete rounds must meet every applicable existing limit and functional/lifecycle requirement.
acceptance.failure_policy: Retain failed, timed-out, interrupted and preflight attempts under distinct identities. Diagnose and fix. A changed candidate/harness/input/configuration starts a new complete initial+confirmation pair. An unchanged-candidate retry also starts a new full pair; never select only favorable attempts or replace a failed cell in an earlier round.
acceptance.preflight: Debugging, fixture preparation and the completed offline art audit remain explicitly separate from authoritative timing. They do not substitute for either full round.
acceptance.invalid_attempt: Retain evidence and the objective reason for interruption/contamination. Rerun the entire pair when conditions are restored; do not relabel poor timings as invalid merely because they missed a limit.
required_artifacts: native raw samples and memory CSV
acceptance.session_completion: S22 remains in_progress until both full rounds and all required accounting/lifecycle/layout cells are accepted. This protocol and offline audit award no S22, G5, CP1 or human-playtest completion.
acceptance.designation: Declare immutable attempt IDs and round roles before launch. A completed preflight or diagnostic run cannot be promoted into qualification after its measurements are known.

pre_qualification_clarification.scope: Before any authoritative timing, specify the local camera-control workload and honest paint-opportunity boundary, and distinguish the released designer aircraft asset from delivered stock. No threshold, window, map GPU-completion definition, case or confirmation rule changes.
pre_qualification_clarification.trace_status: Chrome trace capture remains required evidence and is pending implementation/verification by the browser qualification owner. No trace is claimed by the protocol itself.
